title: Concise sell-sheets + scenario-driven demo playbooks for runtime 1.20 launch
creator: Ava Martinez
objective: Create a minimal set of customer-facing enablement artifacts (one-page sell-sheets, battle-card-lite, CS troubleshooting runbook, and two scenario-based demo flows) to reduce ramp time for field and lower deal cycle friction for runtime-1.20 features (qbatch improvements, KV cache prefetch, and fallback routing).
scope: One-page sell-sheet for AE use (3rd party-friendly language, value props, quick metrics)
Battle-card-lite (2 sides) targeting common buyer personas: Platform Engineer and Product Manager
Two scenario demo playbooks (Quick PLG demo and Technical deep-dive) with step-by-step prompts and expected outputs
CS runbook covering triage steps and escalation for performance regressions and rollout fallbacks
Release notes coordination brief and links to PRDs/engineering notes
deliverables: AE one-page PDF (web + printable) - 1 per persona
Battle-card-lite (A/B variant) - single slide as PNG + speaker notes
Demo playbook: Quick PLG flow (5-7 minute script)
Demo playbook: Tech deep-dive (15-minute script + troubleshooting checklist)
CS runbook doc (triage steps, dashboard links, fallback commands)
Release coordination email template and release-notes summary
distribution_plan: Publish artifacts to Drive under /Enablement/runtime-1.20/, create a short Loom walkthrough for AEs, attach to the release notes entry, and schedule two 30-minute drop-in training sessions during launch week. Notify SalesOps to seed new snippets into Salesforce enablement nodes.
sales_talk_tracks: Value opener: 'With runtime-1.20 we cut median p95 inference cost by X% via smarter batching and KV prefetch — customers see lower token cost with sub-50ms tail latency for typical chat workloads.'
Use-case pitch: 'For product teams building chat-first UX, the KV prefetch reduces cold-turn latency and simplifies prompt engineering — fewer prefix tokens required.'
Pricing/commit: 'Dedicated customers can opt-in to new autoscale settings for predictable throughput; reference Dedicated SKU sheet and reserved capacity commit guidance.'
Close prompt: 'Would you like a short technical review with one of our solutions engineers to map this onto your load profile?'
cs_tickets_and_runbook: Initial triage checklist: confirm model version, deployment tier (hosted/dedicated/private), observed metric (latency/cost/error), recent traffic spikes
Immediate mitigations: enable fallback variant via routing policy, temporarily reduce max_batch_size, enable prefix caching override
Monitoring links: Console -> Route Metrics > p95 latency, Token cost breakdown per route, recent rollouts tab
Escalation path: attach logs + correlation id, open ENG-ops ticket with runtime logs and include performance snapshot (CSV export), notify on-call runtime engineer
Post-incident: fill short RCA template in Drive and propose rollout gating for similar rollouts
demo_scenario_workflows: Quick PLG demo (5-7m): 1) Intro value props, 2) Live sandbox: generate chat with 3-turn conversation showing reduced latency, 3) Show cost tab in Console with token breakdown, 4) Close with Qs and CTA for trial upgrade.

Tech deep-dive (15m): 1) Architecture slide (serving runtime + KV cache), 2) Run live long-form prompt demonstrating batching and prefetch behavior, 3) Toggle quantization profile to show small cost/latency delta, 4) Show fallback routing example and canary rollout metrics, 5) Q&A and next steps for pilot.
Scenario variations: high-throughput conversational app, low-latency assistant, regulated on-prem deployment — each includes comms to Sales/CS on expected metrics and objections.
objections_and_handle_snippets: Objection: 'We can host ourselves and avoid vendor lock.' Handle: 'Redwood focuses on serving optimizations and cost controls that minimize ops burden—we provide predictable SLAs and autoscale policies, and a private deployment package for isolation.'

Objection: 'Upgrading sounds risky for our production flows.' Handle: 'We recommend canary rollout with automatic fallback; the demo playbook includes exact gating metrics and rollback triggers used by our SRE team.'

Objection: 'How will this change our unit economics?' Handle: 'Run the Quick Cost Estimator (link in sell-sheet) with your token profile; runtime-1.20 typically improves tokens-per-second cost for seq lengths >128.'
